output.reason: I find this convincing. Splitting failures by valve source, installer and firmware rules out the installer and firmware explanations. The helium retest, the rig being out of service and the repeated certificate data together show the certificates are fabricated. That fits the January timing of the PCN. The next steps are clear and specific, though the cause at the seal or line level is still unresolved.
